observed_parent_evidence.gap: No current source found that requires a structured intervention-by-sentinel cross-effect matrix or verifies linear compositionality of a rank-2 semantic control basis on fresh held-out families.

new_material_finding.statement: A steering direction can satisfy target-specific semantic controls while inducing structured changes on other behaviors. Therefore bounded target selectivity plus a scalar off-target threshold is insufficient to establish that the direction is a reusable modular HCU/J-Space control primitive.
why_material: EntityOS/HCU ultimately needs reusable control primitives whose interactions are bounded, not merely one-off vectors that improve one target metric.
Structured asymmetric cross-effects can create hidden coupling between logical HCU functions even when each vector passes its own target-specific holdout.
If the semantic simplex is rank-2, linear addition in activation space does not imply linear or separable downstream behavioral effects for coefficient combinations.
A scalar maximum-drift PASS can hide a stable pattern of systematic cross-effects that becomes important when several control dimensions are composed.

primary_hypothesis.statement: The retained Qwen3-0.6B semantic control direction/subspace produces target-selective causal effects while keeping preregistered sentinel cross-effects bounded and, when two dimensions are used together, exhibits sufficiently predictable held-out composition to support a small coefficient-based J-Space control ABI candidate.
primary_hypothesis.prediction: On fresh matched scenario families, intended semantic effects remain selective, the cross-effect matrix is sparse or bounded under calibration-frozen limits, and combined rank-2 interventions are predicted by the preregistered composition model within tolerance.

counterhypotheses.statement: The semantic direction reliably changes multiple non-target behaviors in a structured and asymmetric way, so it is an entangled actuator rather than a modular semantic primitive.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Cross-effect magnitudes and family-consistent signs remain within preregistered sentinel limits while target selectivity persists.

counterhypotheses.statement: Two individually valid semantic basis directions interact non-additively downstream; coefficient combinations cannot be predicted from their separately measured effects.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Held-out combined-intervention effects remain within a calibration-frozen compositional residual tolerance across semantic and sentinel endpoints.

counterhypotheses.statement: Cross-effect predictability reported in external work does not transfer to the exact Qwen3-0.6B layer/runtime/family design.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: A calibration-only forecast derived from unsteered Qwen3-0.6B representations predicts held-out cross-effect sign or magnitude above a preregistered null without being used to select or relabel the holdout result.

external_primary_inputs.source: Ong, Sim, Zhang, Sun (2026), Forecasting Side Effects of Activation Steering, arXiv:2608.11227
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: The paper constructs a cross-effect matrix over 67 behaviors across three open-weight language models and reports that steering side effects are common, structured and often asymmetric; it also reports that side-effect direction can be forecast from unsteered representations better than simple baselines.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_use: Adopt a structured cross-effect matrix and pre-intervention forecasting diagnostic as donors. Do not transfer their empirical result to Qwen3-0.6B without exact model-specific evidence.

external_primary_inputs.source: Han et al. (2026), Steer2Adapt: Dynamically Composing Steering Vectors Elicits Efficient Adaptation of LLMs, arXiv:2602.07276
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: The paper reports useful dynamic composition of steering-vector bases across multiple tasks and models.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_use: Treat vector composition as an experimentally plausible control mechanism, not as evidence that the current Qwen3-0.6B semantic basis composes linearly. Require a model-specific held-out composition residual test.

external_primary_inputs.source: Braun (2026), Understanding Unreliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models: Geometric Predictors and the Limits of Linear Approximations, arXiv:2602.17881
external_primary_inputs.source_direct: The work reports that steering reliability varies across behaviors and argues that unreliability arises when the latent behavior is not effectively approximated by a linear steering direction.
external_primary_inputs.protocol_use: Keep nonlinear/entangled behavior as a live counterhypothesis and do not infer modularity from activation-space linearity alone.

successor_discriminator.name: MATCHED_FAMILY_CROSS_EFFECT_AND_COMPOSITIONALITY_GATE/v1
phase_0_freeze: Freeze exact checkpoint/tokenizer, GGUF where native, llama.cpp or PyTorch runtime/build, activation site/layer, token scope and intervention-vector identities.
Freeze matched scenario-family construction, semantic target x output-code rotation, residual-norm-relative operating point and all v5 controls before holdout.
Define a small sentinel behavior set before holdout. Sentinel tasks must be structurally matched where possible but must not be used to derive the semantic vector.
Freeze per-sentinel standardization, cross-effect thresholds, family aggregation law and compositional residual threshold on calibration only.

phase_1_sentinel_cross_effect_matrix.definition: For semantic intervention i and sentinel behavior k, X[i,k] = equal-family-weighted standardized change under intervention i minus matched baseline on sentinel k.
minimum_sentinels: declared safety/protocol behavior where an exact bounded local metric exists
phase_1_sentinel_cross_effect_matrix.family_rule: Preserve per-family signed cross-effects and report pooled mean, maximum absolute standardized drift and family-consistency; one family may not silently dominate the verdict.

classification.BOUNDED_MODULAR_CONTROL_CANDIDATE: Target-specific semantic selectivity passes while every sentinel stays within preregistered bounds and no structured nuisance control reproduces the target matrix.
classification.ENTANGLED_CONTROL_WITH_STRUCTURED_CROSS_: Target metric passes but one or more sentinel effects exceed bound or show stable unintended structure across held-out families.
classification.FAMILY_SPECIFIC_OR_UNRESOLVED: Cross-effects or target effects are carried by a small subset of families or fail stability criteria.

phase_2_pre_intervention_forecast_diagno.purpose: Test whether Qwen3-0.6B unsteered representations forecast the sign or relative magnitude of held-out cross-effects before intervention.
phase_2_pre_intervention_forecast_diagno.law: Forecasting is diagnostic only. It cannot mint semantic, HCU or canonical credit and cannot be used to adapt thresholds after holdout.
phase_2_pre_intervention_forecast_diagno.null: Compare forecast accuracy/correlation against deterministic label/family-preserving permutation or simple similarity baseline frozen in advance.

phase_3_rank2_compositionality.precondition: Only applicable if the matched blocked simplex gate supports a second semantic dimension above null.
phase_3_rank2_compositionality.single_direction_measurements: Measure each normalized basis direction and sign-flip separately at the same residual-norm-relative dose.
phase_3_rank2_compositionality.combination_grid: Use a small calibration-frozen coefficient grid including positive/negative single-axis and mixed-axis combinations; do not search coefficients on holdout.
phase_3_rank2_compositionality.prediction: For each endpoint e, predict combined effect from the preregistered composition model fitted on calibration-only individual effects.
phase_3_rank2_compositionality.residual: R[c,e] = observed combined held-out effect - predicted combined held-out effect.
phase_3_rank2_compositionality.pass_rule: Absolute standardized residuals remain within the calibration-frozen tolerance for target and sentinel endpoints across fresh families, with no systematic sign interaction missed by the composition model.
phase_3_rank2_compositionality.fail_rule: Large or family-stable residuals classify the control surface as NONLINEAR_OR_ENTANGLED and block a simple linear coefficient ABI promotion.

phase_4_promotion_boundary: Target semantic causality is necessary but not sufficient for modular HCU/J-Space control.
Cross-effect boundedness and rank-2 composition are control-architecture evidence only; they still do not mint canonical truth or real-effect authority.
If side effects are predictable but large, record the forecast utility while still rejecting modular-control promotion.
If rank-2 geometry exists but composition fails, preserve the subspace as measurement evidence and require a nonlinear/gated successor control law rather than forcing a linear ABI.

relationship_to_current_v5_gate.v5_strength: Already requires an off-target drift test, preregistered threshold, receipt, label-free derivation, nuisance control, cross-family coherence, residual-norm calibration and explicit token scope.
relationship_to_current_v5_gate.new_nonduplicate_delta: Replace scalar off-target sufficiency with a structured intervention-by-sentinel cross-effect object and add a distinct rank-2 composition residual gate before any claim that a semantic subspace is a modular coefficient-controlled HCU primitive.
relationship_to_current_v5_gate.implementation_rule: Implement as an additive v6/companion adjudicator after current v5 source/tests are re-read; do not weaken or rewrite v5 historical evidence.

information_gain_assessment.reason: One experiment family can distinguish target-specific but entangled steering from reusable modular control, characterize unintended interactions, and determine whether a rank-2 semantic subspace can safely be represented by simple linear coefficients.
information_gain_assessment.cost_control: Source/protocol work is zero-cost. Future runtime reuses the existing pinned local Qwen3-0.6B/native lane and matched-family design; no paid provider or training is required for the discriminator itself.

decision_value.target_pass_cross_effect_pass_compositio: Strong bounded component evidence for a modular low-dimensional J-Space control candidate; still no canonical semantics or whole-HCU credit.
decision_value.target_pass_cross_effect_fail: Semantic actuator is entangled; do not expose as generic reusable control primitive.
decision_value.target_pass_rank2_composition_fail: Keep representation/subspace evidence but require nonlinear or gated coefficient control.
decision_value.forecast_success_but_cross_effect_large: Forecasting is useful for audit/routing, but modular-control promotion remains rejected.
decision_value.all_fail: Prior apparent semantic control is insufficiently robust for reusable HCU/J-Space abstraction.

coordination.reason: This standalone research trigger exposes no canonical shared immutable go-macrocycle/request identity and no successful create-only unusual-experiment lease. This delta is source/web research and protocol formation only.

research_delta: Forschungsrun 1 adds a nonduplicate promotion boundary above current semantic-specificity and simplex gates: successful target steering must be separated from modular control. The successor explicitly measures structured cross-effects on preregistered sentinel behaviors and, for rank-2 candidates, tests held-out compositional residuals. This prevents an entangled or nonlinear actuator from being exposed as a simple reusable HCU/J-Space coefficient-controlled primitive merely because its target semantic metric passes.
next_exact_action: Re-enter current main, then add an additive fail-closed companion/v6 adjudicator schema for structured cross-effect evidence and rank-2 compositional residuals only if no parallel implementation has landed; execute new native interventions only after canonical unusual-experiment coordination.
